mission_phase: Generation 36 - Dataset x retailer search scoreboard (Home Improvement: Home Depot + Lowe's)
phase_goal: Turn the browser-driven search evaluation into a dataset x retailer scoreboard. Sites are grouped by domain (Home Improvement: Home Depot + Lowe's) in the sidebar. A scoreboard shows each search dataset (synonym mapping first; future datasets slot in) with a score per retailer; clicking a score drills to that retailer's cases, and each case links to the actual live search on that retailer's site (the rerun/verify). The score is understandable from the UI and never a dead end.
reason_generation_started: Operator: group sites by domain (home improvement); build several datasets; run the evals on the datasets for Home Depot and Lowe's; in the UI show the dataset score for each retailer, drillable to the actual live call with rerun. Extensible to future datasets the operator is drafting.
standing_directive: Scores and cases come only from captured browser-driven evidence (bounded, same-origin, real session; no crawling/API/token-replay). 'Rerun' = opening the live search in the operator browser. Do not fabricate counts. Do not apply destructive cleanup.

functional: Home Depot and Lowe's appear grouped under a Home Improvement domain in the sidebar.
A scoreboard shows the synonym dataset with a score for Home Depot and a score for Lowe's; each score is a navigable control that drills to that retailer's per-pair cases.
Each case shows the two terms, the retailer's result counts, and a link to the exact live search on that retailer (the rerun); no score or case is a dead end.
The structure is dataset-generic so future datasets appear as additional scoreboard rows.
usability: Interactive holistic walkthrough (as-a-user): open the scoreboard, read synonym HD score vs Lowe's score, drill into a score, open a live search; Shopify/Woo sites unaffected.
No inspection triggered; no server-side fetching of the retailers.
technical: validate:dashboard asserts the search-datasets API returns datasets with per-retailer scores + cases and the view wires the scoreboard + drill-down; Lowe's listed under the Home Improvement domain; validate:gen13 and validate stay green; git diff --check clean.

validation_notes: VAL-085: domain grouping + scoreboard (HD 30% vs Lowe's 48%) + cross-retailer drill + live rerun links; two clean passes; BDD-INV-025.
known_gaps_opened: Lowe's scored on 23 common pairs (throttle after ~50 fetches); can extend to the full set later.
Future datasets (the operator is drafting) slot in as additional scoreboard rows once captured.
